name: sdk-grid
title: SDK grid
description: Official libraries as cards: language, version, a written status, a copyable install command and links to docs and source, plus a card for community libraries.
docs: Pass sdks (an id, a label, the install command, the version, a status of stable, beta or community, and the docs and source links) and, optionally, communityHref for a last dashed card that says plainly those libraries are not official. The status is always a word with its own shape: a check for Stable, a flask for Beta, a group for Community. The install command is real text in a copy field, and each copy button is named after its language, so a page of eight does not give a screen reader eight identical buttons. A command that does not fit beside its button wraps, with the button under it, instead of hiding behind a scrollbar. Give an sdk a mark (a logo or glyph at 22px) or let the card show the first letters of its name. The block has no state of its own and renders on the server. Words are translated through labels.
